name: focus
mood: The Quiet Grove: a hushed library-greenhouse for deep focus. Dark walnut, moss-green carpet, worn leather, brass reading lamps, ferns and trailing plants, a crackling stone fireplace. Cozy, still, scholarly.

items.prompt: A tall dark walnut library bookcase with carved crown molding, packed with old leather-bound books in deep reds, greens and browns, a brass bookend and a trailing ivy plant. Its open front faces along the red arrow.
The SAME tall dark walnut library bookcase seen from behind: its plain walnut back panel with carved crown molding on top.
A matching tall dark walnut bookcase with glass-paned upper doors holding books, a small globe and a potted fern, and closed walnut cupboards below. Its front faces along the red arrow.
The SAME dark walnut glass-door bookcase seen from behind: its plain walnut back panel.
A cozy stone fireplace with a dark walnut mantel holding a candle and a small clock, a crackling orange fire behind a brass guard, a basket of logs beside it. Its opening faces along the red arrow.
The SAME stone fireplace seen from behind: its rough stone back and the chimney breast, the walnut mantel's edge.
A worn rust-brown leather wingback reading armchair with brass nailhead trim, a tartan throw over one arm and dark walnut legs.
The SAME rust leather wingback armchair seen from behind: the tall curved wing back with brass nailheads, walnut legs.
A deep bottle-green velvet wingback reading armchair with brass nailhead trim and dark walnut legs, a small cushion.
The SAME bottle-green velvet wingback armchair seen from behind: the tall curved wing back, walnut legs.

A dark walnut writing desk two tiles long with a green leather inlay, a brass banker's lamp with a green glass shade, a stack of books, an open notebook and a fountain pen. The drawer side faces along the red arrow.
The SAME dark walnut writing desk seen from behind: its plain walnut modesty panel, the green banker's lamp and books on top.
A dark walnut library chair with a curved spindle back and a green leather seat pad.
The SAME walnut spindle-back library chair seen from directly behind: the spindles of the backrest nearest to us.
A small oval brass plaque on a dark walnut mount, slightly wider than tall, engraved with a simple finger-to-lips 'shh' silhouette and tiny leaves around the edge (no letters).
